description: Image Description: The image shows a large floral arrangement in a light beige ceramic pot. The bouquet includes a variety of flowers: prominently featured are white lilies with long petals, vibrant orange and red heliconia flowers with their distinctive elongated shape, and clusters of purple alliums. There are also green ferns and variegated leaves adding texture and contrast to the arrangement.
